request: Inspect incorrect arm and leg motion in walking, running, jumping and attacks; fix and verify in the actual game.
findings: Five-metre-per-second movement selected Walk and used an unrelated 3.8 reference speed; actual stance contact speed was much lower. Arm/leg opposite phase was already correct and was preserved.
Axe windup target exceeded arm reach. Key-pose interpolation also straightened the elbow between otherwise valid keys.
The 1.0417-second donor Punch was interrupted by the real 0.55-second attack cooldown; its hands were open.
Final SkeletonModifier bone positions must be sampled during modification_processed. Reads outside that signal omitted final pitch/elbow corrections and produced misleading acceptance data.
changes: Select walk/jog from measured physical motion; use body-specific stance speed and uniform visual scale for rate. Preserve normalized foot phase through Walk/Run and moving combat transitions.

Use reachable axe windup, torso turn/lean and continuous minimum elbow bend during the active stroke, fading near rest. Preserve actual attack rate/damage contact and independent blade-position limits.
Fit complete punch and recovery to the existing attack cooldown, shorten entry blend and close both hands in palm space. Existing free-hand curl checks verify release after Punch.
Extend existing mandatory locomotion/grip tests; add reusable graphical phase and physical-input fixtures. Record final modified bone poses and reject missing snapshots.

World input fixture checks pending bow immediately after dispatch and samples early enough within the same draw window. Preserve total wait, arrow/mana/save assertions and minimum 20 distinct rendered final poses; repeat real shots if needed for coverage.

verification_notes: Graphical tests opened the real Godot source project and used normal action input for physical motion. Observer camera and isolated profiles were used; this was not a manual free-roam or city tour. Slow-walk fixture temporarily uses walk_speed=1.8; normal keyboard move speed remains 5 and sprint remains 8.
Stride guard measures median backward forefoot speed only near contact height; peak ankle speed included heel roll and was rejected as a proxy. The 15-percent physical-speed assertion was retained.

Axe candidates failing original blade z <= -0.9 were rejected, not accommodated by relaxing the guard. Intermediate raw-pose failures were traced to the Godot sampling lifecycle, then replaced by final modifier snapshots.

Earlier wrapper timeouts and stale result files were not accepted. The direct test runner uses bounded processes. A gameplay marker typo was corrected to the original success marker; a fresh gameplay run also passed.
A prior world observation missed the short draw window after eight physics frames; two early frames plus 51 remaining frames preserve the total wait and the gameplay assertions.
The source-world pass and locomotion/gameplay passes preceded only the final unarmed Punch finger branch. Weapon, static and physical-action fixtures were rerun after that branch.
